description: Add Supabase Realtime (additive, non-breaking) to the shopping list (lib/shopping_list_screen.dart) and tasks (lib/tasks_screen.dart) screens so that when the OTHER household member checks a shopping item or claims a 'Bolsa Comun' task, the current user's screen refreshes instantly without manual reload. Includes: a migration 0043 that adds both tables to the supabase_realtime publication; a PURE, unit-tested helper for realtime-event handling (own-echo detection / reconciliation decision); and silent error handling via a discreet card-style SnackBar (BorderRadius 16, floating) shown ONCE. All existing behavior must stay intact (_toggleChecked/_addToPantry, claimAndComplete, Dismissible, confetti/ShoppingCelebrationGate, aisle grouping, points-module gating). If realtime fails, the app keeps working exactly as today via FutureBuilder/_reload.
steps: DECIDE AND DOCUMENT the Realtime API. Recommended: use `_client.channel('<name>').onPostgresChanges(event: PostgresChangeEvent.all, schema: 'public', table: '<table>', filter: PostgresChangeFilter(type: PostgresChangeFilterType.eq, column: 'home_id', value: <homeId>), callback: ...)` then `.subscribe((status, [err]) {...})`. In the callback, trigger an idempotent refresh of existing state (reuse the screen's existing fetch via _reload) rather than hand-merging rows. Justify this choice in the feature findings: it reconciles authoritatively against the DB (no divergence), it is idempotent so a user's own write and its realtime echo converge to the same state (no duplicates/flicker), and it keeps all current fetch/grouping/gating logic untouched. The home_id eq filter plus existing RLS means a client only receives its own household's changes (defense in depth per security.md). One channel per live screen is acceptable per the briefing.

CREATE a pure, testable helper in lib/utils/ (e.g. lib/utils/realtime_sync.dart). Put the non-UI decision logic here as pure functions / a small stateful class, following the exact style of lib/utils/shopping_celebration.dart. Suggested surface: (a) a pure function/class that decides, given a stream of channel subscription statuses, whether to show the 'sin conexion en vivo' notice exactly ONCE (de-dupe: once shown, do not re-notify until a successful reconnect resets it); and/or (b) a pure helper that debounces/decides whether an incoming postgres-change event should trigger a reload (e.g. ignore events while a local write is in flight, or always-reload-idempotently). Keep it free of Supabase types so it is unit-testable. Document in findings exactly which pure logic you extracted and why.

shopping_list_screen.dart: in initState, after kicking off the first _fetch, resolve the home_id (reuse the existing _homeId() pattern; do it without blocking the UI) and open ONE realtime channel on table 'shopping_list_items' filtered by home_id. On any insert/update/delete event, call the existing _reload() (guarded by `if (!mounted) return;`). Store the channel in a field. In dispose(), close it with `_client.removeChannel(channel)` (or channel.unsubscribe()) and guard against setState-after-dispose. Do NOT change _toggleChecked, _addToPantry, _deleteItem, the Dismissible, the ShoppingCelebrationGate/confetti, the cost estimate card, or the aisle grouping slivers. Because the screen is embedded in DespensaTab inside an always-alive IndexedStack, make sure the channel is opened exactly once (not re-opened on rebuilds) and closed in dispose.

tasks_screen.dart: mirror the same approach for table 'tasks' filtered by home_id. In initState resolve home_id and open ONE channel; on events call the existing _reload() guarded by `if (!mounted) return;`. Close the channel in dispose(). Keep _complete, _claim (claimAndComplete), _delete, _openAdd, the Bolsa Comun section, the scoreboard/points chart and the HomeModule.points gating untouched. Note TasksScreen is a direct always-alive IndexedStack child: open once, close in dispose, never leave channels dangling.

AVOID the echo/duplicate problem: because _reload() re-queries the DB and rebuilds state keyed by row id (fromMap), a user's own write and its realtime echo converge to the SAME authoritative snapshot, so there is no flicker or duplicate. If you add any debounce/coalescing, keep that decision in the pure helper and document it. Do NOT optimistically double-apply the local write and the echo.

SILENT ERROR HANDLING: capture channel subscription errors/closures defensively (the `.subscribe((status, [error]) {...})` callback exposes RealtimeSubscribeStatus.channelError / .timedOut / closed states). On a genuine failure, show a DISCREET card-style SnackBar EXACTLY ONCE using the pure 'notify once' helper to gate it: `SnackBar(behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating, shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)), content: Text('Sin conexion en vivo ahora mismo; se actualizara al recargar.'))`. No red error background, no blocking UI, no technical jargon, NO 'IA'. Never call ScaffoldMessenger after dispose (guard with if(!mounted)). The screens must keep functioning via FutureBuilder/_reload if realtime is down.

CREATE a migration supabase/migrations/0043_realtime_publication_compra_tareas.sql that adds both tables to the supabase_realtime publication, IDEMPOTENTLY. Use a DO block that checks pg_publication_tables before adding, so re-running does not fail if they are already present, e.g. for each of public.shopping_list_items and public.tasks: `do $$ begin if not exists (select 1 from pg_publication_tables where pubname='supabase_realtime' and schemaname='public' and tablename='shopping_list_items') then alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.shopping_list_items; end if; end $$;` and the same for tasks. Header comment in Spanish explaining why (Postgres only emits changes for tables in the publication; RLS already restricts by home_id so clients only get their own household's changes). Ensure: filename matches NNNN_nombre.sql (4 digits), parentheses balanced, file ends with ';'. This is NOT an RLS/policy change.

ADD unit tests in test/ (e.g. test/realtime_sync_test.dart) for the pure helper, following the style of test/shopping_celebration_test.dart. Cover: the 'notify once' gate fires only once across repeated error statuses and resets after a successful (re)subscribe; and whatever reconciliation/own-echo decision function you extracted (truth table of its branches). Net test count MUST NOT drop below the baseline 281 (it should increase).

Run `flutter pub get` and discard autogenerated edits (`git checkout -- pubspec.lock analysis_options.yaml` and any plugin registrant / .flutter-plugins-dependencies changes). Run the full CI verification (format on '.', analyze, test, dependency-map guard). If dependency_map --check fails because new lib/ files were added, regenerate with `dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart` and commit docs/architecture/dependency-map.md.

Record findings: which Realtime API was used and why; how own-echo/duplicates are avoided; how channels are managed in initState/dispose within the IndexedStack; the silent-error SnackBar design (radius 16, floating, once); that migration 0043 was created and which tables it adds; which pure logic was tested; and the final test count.
acceptance_criteria: When another household member checks/unchecks a shopping_list_items row or claims a Bolsa Comun task, the current screen updates without manual reload (implemented via channel.onPostgresChanges -> _reload filtered by home_id)
No new runtime dependency added (supabase_flutter ^2.17.2 only)
Each screen opens exactly ONE realtime channel in initState and closes it in dispose (removeChannel/unsubscribe); no setState/ScaffoldMessenger after dispose (guarded by if(!mounted))

On realtime failure the UI is NOT blocked and no error screen appears; at most a discreet card-style SnackBar (RoundedRectangleBorder radius 16, floating, friendly Spanish, no 'IA') shown exactly ONCE

Existing behavior preserved: _toggleChecked/_addToPantry, _deleteItem, Dismissible, ShoppingCelebrationGate/confetti, aisle grouping, cost card (shopping); _complete/_claim(claimAndComplete)/_delete, Bolsa Comun, scoreboard/points chart, HomeModule.points gating (tasks)

Migration supabase/migrations/0043_realtime_publication_compra_tareas.sql exists, is idempotent, adds public.shopping_list_items and public.tasks to supabase_realtime, matches NNNN_nombre.sql, has balanced parens and ends with ';'
A pure helper (lib/utils/realtime_sync.dart or similar) with no Supabase types holds the testable decision logic and is covered by test/*_test.dart
No 'IA'/'AI' or technical jargon in any user-visible string; theme tokens used (no Colors.grey[xxx], no 0xFF literals)
verification: flutter pub get && git checkout -- pubspec.lock analysis_options.yaml
dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check || (dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart && echo 'regenerated dependency-map.md')
findings:
Realtime API: used `_client.channel('public:<table>:<homeId>').onPostgresChanges(event: PostgresChangeEvent.all, schema: 'public', table: <table>, filter: PostgresChangeFilter(type: eq, column: 'home_id', value: homeId), callback: (_) => _reload()).subscribe((status,[err]) => _onChannelStatus(status))`. Chose event:all -> existing _reload() (re-query DB) over hand-merging rows because it reconciles authoritatively against the DB (no divergence), is idempotent (own write + its echo converge to the SAME snapshot keyed by row id via fromMap, so no duplicates/flicker), and leaves all fetch/grouping/gating logic untouched. The home_id eq filter + existing RLS means a client only receives its own household's changes (defense in depth per security.md).

Own-echo/duplicates: avoided purely by idempotent re-query. _reload() recomputes _fetch()/_load() and setState rebuilds state keyed by id, so a local write and its realtime echo both resolve to one authoritative snapshot. No optimistic double-apply, no debounce needed.

Channel lifecycle in the always-alive IndexedStack: each screen opens EXACTLY ONE channel in initState via a fire-and-forget _subscribeRealtime() (resolves home_id without blocking the FutureBuilder-driven first load), stores it in a `RealtimeChannel? _channel` field, and closes it in dispose() with `_client.removeChannel(channel)` (nulling the field). The postgres callback and status handler guard with `if (!mounted) return;` so no setState/ScaffoldMessenger after dispose. shopping_list_screen is embedded in DespensaTab; tasks_screen is a direct IndexedStack child — both stay alive in the background with one channel each, which the briefing allows.

Silent-error SnackBar: `SnackBar(behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating, shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppRadius.md /*=16*/)), content: Text('Sin conexion en vivo ahora mismo; se actualizara al recargar.'))`. Card look, friendly Spanish, NO red background, NO 'IA'/jargon, never blocks the UI (FutureBuilder/_reload keeps working if realtime is down). Shown EXACTLY ONCE via the pure RealtimeNoticeGate across repeated channelError/timedOut/closed; a successful `subscribed` rearms the gate.

Migration 0043_realtime_publication_compra_tareas.sql: idempotent DO blocks that check pg_publication_tables before `alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.shopping_list_items` and `... public.tasks`. Not an RLS/policy change. Spanish header explains Postgres only emits changes for tables in the publication and that RLS by home_id already restricts cross-household data. Filename 4 digits, balanced parens, ends with ';'.

Pure logic tested: new lib/utils/realtime_sync.dart (free of Supabase types) with (a) `RealtimeChannelState` enum + pure `isRealtimeFailure(state)`, and (b) `RealtimeNoticeGate` (notify-once gate: first failure fires once, repeats suppressed, a `subscribed` or `reset()` rearms). test/realtime_sync_test.dart covers the truth table (fires once, suppresses repeats, rearms on reconnect, reset). The screens translate Supabase's RealtimeSubscribeStatus to this pure enum.

Verification (CI-exact): `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` -> 0 changed; `flutter analyze` -> No issues found!; `flutter test` -> All tests passed, 288 (baseline 281, +7 new); dependency map regenerated (utils 7->8, screens->utils 5->7) and `--check` passes; migration grep for 'realtime' OK. Autogenerated files (pubspec.lock, analysis_options.yaml, plugin registrants, .flutter-plugins-dependencies) discarded and NOT committed. No new runtime dependency (supabase_flutter ^2.17.2 only).

REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-10-04-203510-review, NEEDS_CHANGES -> addressed): (1) DELETE sync gap: added `alter table public.shopping_list_items replica identity full;` and `alter table public.tasks replica identity full;` to migration 0043 (before the publication DO blocks) with a Spanish header paragraph explaining that by default DELETE events carry only the PK, so the home_id filter can't evaluate them and drops them; REPLICA IDENTITY FULL makes DELETE carry the full old row so the filter matches and deletions sync live. Not an RLS/policy change; RLS still blocks cross-household delivery. (2) Duplicate channel: ShoppingListScreen is mounted twice (embedded in DespensaTab's IndexedStack AND pushed as a route from home_tab); made the channel topic instance-unique by appending `identityHashCode(this)` -> `public:shopping_list_items:$homeId:<id>`, so each state owns/tears down its own channel with no topic collision or cross-teardown. Applied the same unique-topic scheme to tasks_screen for consistency (it is single-instance via main_shell, so no collision was possible there). (3) Inconsistent notice on auth/config failure: shopping's _subscribeRealtime no longer calls the throwing _homeId(); it now resolves home_id inline exactly like tasks (read currentUser + profiles.home_id via maybeSingle) and `return`s silently on missing user/home instead of routing to the 'sin conexión en vivo' notice. The notice now fires only for genuine channel/connectivity failures. (4) Accents: SnackBar copy corrected to 'Sin conexión en vivo ahora mismo; se actualizará al recargar.' in BOTH screens. Re-verified: format 0 changed, analyze clean, 288 tests pass, dependency-map --check up to date (no new lib/ files, so no regeneration needed).
